description:
Found while building fz-sc8.8. Reproduces on b870f5a87, so it predates .8.

Three resources with a printing destructor are made in main; twelve small binaries are then built and concatenated and the result printed; main returns :before. `fz2 interp` prints the concatenation and then `dtor:30`, `dtor:20`, `dtor:10`. `fz2 run` prints the concatenation and no `dtor:` line at all, exit 0. With fewer allocations before the return, run prints the destructors too.

Surfaced as `matrix::resource_lifecycle::run` on the first .8 build (when `fz_io_write` was declared `:: :ok` and boxed one atom per print); with `:: unit` the fixture is green again, so the bug is latent, not fixed. Repro: session scratchpad p8/bug_jit_resource_dtor_lost_after_allocation.fz.
title: A JIT process skips its resource destructors once enough heap has been allocated
